An Instant Is Seconds and Nanoseconds Counted From 1970-01-01T00:00Z
An Instant Has No Calendar, So Months Need a Zone
A Timestamp Survives a Store Only at the Store's Precision

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-offset-text: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-offset-text: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-offset-text: Section 'Instant.parse Accepts Only Text That Names Its Offset': "reads the ISO form with a `Z` or a numeric offset, and converts an offset to UTC"; the run shows 2026-03-14T10:30:00+01:00 -> 09:30:00Z. The same rule gives 23:15-04:00 -> 03:15Z on the next day.
recorded.prompt:q-before-epoch: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-before-epoch: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-before-epoch: First section: nanos run "from 0 to 999,999,999"; "Half a second before the epoch is second -1 plus half a second, because the nanosecond part never goes negative" (output seconds=-1 nanos=500000000). By the same pattern, -1.25 s is -2 + 0.75 s.
